scope: Inherited source versus native contracts; evolving port not executed or accepted

findings.finding: Firm memory write produces pending_review receipt with activeItemUnchanged, while old consumer treats any fulfilled write as saved/covered.
findings.requiredHandling: Validate pending receipt and represent review submission; keep active versus proposed content distinct.

findings.finding: SetupTaskStatus contains skipped for reads but native transition DTO excludes it.
findings.requiredHandling: Separate request enum from read status; use capability skip endpoint and reconcile 409.

findings.finding: Nullable purchaser names and payment secrets/URLs plus native sessionId/failureReason/stripe differ from old frontend interfaces.
findings.requiredHandling: Preserve native nullability; bind available sessionId; do not invent usable payment state.

findings.finding: Old IT page enables Microsoft if providers metadata is absent; native view explicitly returns booleans.
findings.requiredHandling: Require current valid availability; unavailable metadata cannot enable action.

findings.classification: gateway resource requirement, not demonstrated native failure
findings.finding: Native signed PDF has fixed filenames/MIME but no explicit response byte ceiling; old helper buffers arbitrary size and parses untrusted filename.
findings.requiredHandling: Reuse bounded binary response owner and registered PDF filenames/no-store/nosniff; explicit local resource bound.

findings.finding: IT provider origins/paths are determinable; Stripe invoice URL is forwarded without an owner-published origin allowlist; config URLs cannot choose gateway destinations.
findings.requiredHandling: Exact reviewed provider/redirect policies; reject arbitrary origins, credentials and paths; preserve native callbacks.
